name: Copy Visual Text (y, p, P)

metadata.author: GeekP1e
learningObjectives: Copy selected characters with y, then use p after the cursor and P before it without inserting whole lines.

instructions: Fill both keyboard rows. The cursor is on 8 in mouse,89,12. Press v4ly to select and copy the five characters 89,12, then k$p to paste after the comma in keyboard,. Next press 0v8ly to copy keyboard, and G0P to insert that prefix before the final row's values. P is uppercase (Shift+p).
